### How to Add or Swap Images:
1. Simply drop your new image file (PNG, JPG, WebP) into this `public/assets/projects/` folder.
2. Open `src/projectsData.js` and update or add the corresponding project entry (title, image path, category, description, and tools).
3. The project grid and interactive case study modal will immediately reflect the changes!
